name: DB Incline Curl
why: Arms hang behind you: biceps stretched.
setup: Bench at 45–60°, head and shoulders on it.
Arms hanging straight, palms forward.
form: Curl up.
Lower until your arms are straight.

preferred.why: Arm behind the body stretches the long head; grew the upper biceps most in a trial.

name: Barbell Preacher Curl
why: Biceps work hardest near the bottom.
setup: Armpits at the top of the pad, upper arms flat on it.
EZ bar if a straight bar hurts your wrists.
form: Curl up, stop just before your forearms are upright.
Lower until your arms are almost straight.
avoid: Dropping fast at the bottom (hard on the elbows).
rangeOfMotion: Arms almost straight → forearms almost upright

name: DB Hammer Curl
why: Heavy curl, palms in. Thicker arms.
setup: Palms facing in, elbows at your sides.
form: Curl one arm at a time to your shoulder.
Lower all the way.

preferred.why: Neutral grip adds brachialis and forearm work.

name: Barbell Curl
why: The basic heavy curl.
setup: Hands shoulder-width, palms up.
Elbows at your sides.
form: Curl the bar to your shoulders.
Lower until your arms are straight.

preferred.why: Heaviest loadable curl; curl strength is specific to the curl trained.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
why: Barbell curl on the bent bar: easier on the wrists.
setup: Hands on the angled grips, palms up.
Elbows at your sides.
form: Curl the bar to your shoulders.
Lower until your arms are straight.

preferred.why: Heavy curl that is easier on the wrists; curl strength is specific to the curl trained.

name: Close-Grip EZ Bar Curl
why: EZ-bar curl with hands on the inner grips.
setup: Hands on the inner angled grips.
Elbows at your sides.
form: Curl the bar to your chest.
Lower until your arms are straight.

name: Close-Grip Standing Barbell Curl
why: Straight-bar curl with hands closer than your shoulders.
setup: Hands a bit inside shoulder-width, palms up.
Elbows at your sides.
form: Curl the bar to your chest.
Lower until your arms are straight.

name: Wide-Grip Standing Barbell Curl
why: Straight-bar curl with hands wider than your shoulders.
setup: Hands a bit outside shoulder-width, palms up.
Elbows at your sides.
form: Curl the bar to your chest.
Lower until your arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
why: Standing dumbbell curl.
setup: A dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Elbows at your sides.
form: Curl up to your shoulders, both arms or one at a time.
Lower until your arms are straight.

name: Seated Dumbbell Curl
why: Dumbbell curl sitting down: less swinging.
setup: Sit on the end of a bench, back straight.
Dumbbells hanging, palms forward.
form: Curl up to your shoulders.
Lower until your arms are straight.

name: Standing Inner-Biceps Curl
why: Dumbbell curl out to the sides.
setup: Dumbbells at your sides, palms in.
Elbows close to your body.
form: Curl out and up, turning palms up, to shoulder height.
Lower the same way.
rangeOfMotion: Arms straight → dumbbells beside your shoulders

name: Seated Dumbbell Inner Biceps Curl
why: Seated dumbbell curl out to the sides.
setup: Sit on the end of a bench.
Dumbbells at your sides, palms in.
form: Curl out and up, turning palms up, to shoulder height.
Lower the same way.
rangeOfMotion: Arms straight → dumbbells beside your shoulders

name: Incline Inner Biceps Curl
why: Incline curl out to the sides: biceps stretched.
setup: Bench at 45°, back on it.
Arms hanging, palms facing out.
form: Curl out and up to beside your shoulders.
Lower the same way.
rangeOfMotion: Arms straight → dumbbells beside your shoulders

name: Incline Barbell Curl
aliases: Barbell Curls Lying Against An Incline
why: Barbell curl with your back on an incline: arms behind you.
setup: Bench at 45°, back on it.
Bar hanging at arm's length.
form: Curl the bar up as high as you can.
Lower all the way.

name: Lying Supine Dumbbell Curl
why: Curl lying on a flat bench, arms hanging below it: big stretch.
setup: Lie face up on a high flat bench.
Arms hanging down past the bench, palms in.
form: Curl up, turning palms up.
Lower until your arms are straight.
tips: Go light: the bottom is very stretched.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
why: Arm behind you on a cable: biceps stretched and loaded the whole way.
setup: Pulley low. Face away, handle in one hand.
Step forward until your arm is pulled behind you.
form: Curl up, keeping your elbow back.
Lower until your arm is straight.
rangeOfMotion: Arm straight behind you → full curl

preferred.why: Top-rated curl: loads the biceps long head in its stretch.

name: Drag Curl
why: Bar slides up your body, elbows go back.
setup: Hands shoulder-width, palms up, bar against your thighs.
form: Drag the bar up your body, elbows moving back.
Slide it back down the same way.
rangeOfMotion: Bar at your thighs → bar at your chest

name: Spider Curl
why: Chest on a bench, arms hanging straight down: hardest at the top.
setup: Chest on an angled or high bench.
Bar hanging at arm's length, palms up.
form: Curl up and squeeze.
Lower until your arms are straight.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Dumbbell Prone Incline Curl
why: Chest on an incline bench, arms hanging: hardest at the top.
setup: Lie face down on an incline bench.
Arms hanging straight down, palms forward.
form: Curl up and squeeze.
Lower until your arms are straight.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
aliases: Standing One-Arm Dumbbell Curl Over Incline Bench
why: Preacher curl with dumbbells: biceps work hardest near the bottom.
setup: Upper arm flat on a preacher pad or the back of an incline bench.
One arm or both.
form: Curl up, stop just before your forearm is upright.
Lower until your arm is almost straight.
rangeOfMotion: Arm almost straight → forearm almost upright

preferred.why: Top-rated curl: hardest at the bottom; grew the lower biceps most in trials.

name: Cable Preacher Curl
why: Preacher curl on a cable: tension the whole way.
setup: Preacher bench in front of a low pulley.
Upper arms flat on the pad, bar in hand.
form: Curl up to your chin.
Lower until your arms are almost straight.

name: Machine Bicep Curl
why: Machine curl, arms on a pad: easy to push hard.
setup: Seat so your elbows line up with the pivot.
Upper arms flat on the pad.
form: Curl the handles up.
Lower until your arms are almost straight.
avoid: Lifting your elbows off the pad.

name: Concentration Curl
why: One arm, elbow braced on your thigh: strict.
setup: Sit, elbow against your inner thigh.
Arm hanging straight.
form: Curl up and squeeze.
Lower until your arm is straight.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Standing Concentration Curl
why: Concentration curl bent over, arm hanging free.
setup: Bend forward, free hand on your knee or a bench.
Working arm hanging straight down.
form: Curl up to your chest and squeeze.
Lower until your arm is straight.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Seated Close-Grip Concentration Barbell Curl
why: Concentration curl with a bar, both arms braced.
setup: Sit, upper arms on your inner thighs.
Hands close, palms up.
form: Curl the bar up and squeeze.
Lower until your arms are straight.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Standing Biceps Cable Curl
why: Cable curl: tension the whole way.
setup: Bar on a low pulley, palms up.
Stand close, elbows at your sides.
form: Curl the bar to your chest.
Lower until your arms are straight.

name: Standing One-Arm Cable Curl
why: One-arm cable curl.
setup: Handle on a low pulley.
Stand side-on or facing it, elbow at your side.
form: Curl up to your shoulder.
Lower until your arm is straight.

name: High Cable Curl
why: Curl from two high pulleys, arms out at shoulder height.
setup: Stand between two high pulleys, a handle in each hand.
Arms out to the sides, level with the floor.
form: Curl your hands to your ears, squeeze.
rangeOfMotion: Arms out straight → hands at your ears
tempo: Curl 1 s · Hold 1 s · Straighten 3 s

name: Lying Cable Curl
why: Cable curl lying on the floor: no swinging.
setup: Lie on your back, feet toward a low pulley.
Bar in hand, elbows at your sides.
form: Curl the bar to your chest.
Lower until your arms are almost straight.
rangeOfMotion: Arms almost straight → bar at your chest

name: Lying High Pulley Cable Curl
aliases: Lying Close-Grip Bar Curl On High Pulley
why: Lying cable curl with arms pointing up: arms in front of you.
setup: Lie on a bench in front of a high pulley, head toward it.
Arms straight up over your shoulders, palms up, hands shoulder-width.
form: Curl the bar down to your chin, squeeze.
avoid: Letting the bar pull your arms back.
rangeOfMotion: Arms straight up → bar at your chin
tempo: Curl 1 s · Hold 1 s · Straighten 3 s

name: Rope Hammer Curl
why: Hammer curl on a cable with a rope.
setup: Rope on a low pulley, palms facing in.
Elbows at your sides.
form: Curl the rope to your shoulders.
Lower until your arms are straight.

name: Cross Body Hammer Curl
why: Hammer curl across your body.
setup: Dumbbells at your sides, palms in.
form: Curl one dumbbell up across your body toward the other shoulder.
Lower and switch arms.
rangeOfMotion: Arm straight → dumbbell at the other shoulder

name: Reverse Barbell Curl
why: Curl with palms down: brachialis and forearms.
setup: Palms down, hands shoulder-width.
Elbows at your sides.
form: Curl the bar to your shoulders.
Lower until your arms are straight.

name: Reverse Cable Curl
why: Curl with palms down: brachialis and forearms.
setup: Bar on a low pulley, palms down, hands shoulder-width.
Elbows at your sides.
form: Curl the bar to your shoulders.
Lower until your arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
why: Curl with palms down: brachialis and forearms.
setup: Dumbbells at your sides, palms facing back.
Elbows at your sides.
form: Curl the dumbbells to your shoulders, palms staying down.
Lower until your arms are straight.

name: Reverse EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
why: Curl with palms down: brachialis and forearms.
setup: Upper arms flat on the preacher pad.
EZ bar, palms down, hands shoulder-width.
form: Curl the bar up to your shoulders.
Lower until your arms are straight.

name: Incline Hammer Curl
why: Hammer curl on an incline bench, arms behind you.
setup: Bench at 45°, back on it.
Arms hanging, palms in.
form: Curl up to your shoulders.
Lower until your arms are straight.

name: Preacher Hammer Curl
why: Hammer curl on a preacher pad: strict, hard at the bottom.
setup: Upper arm flat on the preacher pad, palm in.
form: Curl up, stop just before your forearm is upright.
Lower until your arm is almost straight.
rangeOfMotion: Arm almost straight → forearm almost upright

name: Zottman Curl
why: Curl up palms up, lower palms down.
setup: Dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
form: Curl up to your shoulders.
At the top turn your palms down, then lower.

name: Zottman Preacher Curl
why: Zottman curl on a preacher pad.
setup: Upper arms flat on the pad, palms up.
form: Curl up.
At the top turn your palms down, then lower.

name: Incline Cable Curl
aliases: Two-Arm Cable Curl on Incline Bench
why: Incline curl on cables: arms behind you, tension the whole way.
setup: Incline bench between two low pulleys.
Lie back, a handle in each hand, arms hanging behind you.
form: Curl up, keeping your elbows back.
Lower until your arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell Drag Curl
why: Drag curl with dumbbells: weights slide up your sides, elbows go back.
setup: Dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
form: Drag the dumbbells up your body, elbows moving back.
Slide them back down the same way.
rangeOfMotion: Arms straight → dumbbells at your chest

name: Cable Drag Curl
why: Drag curl on a low cable: steady tension, elbows go back.
setup: Bar on a low pulley, palms up.
Stand close, bar against your thighs.
form: Drag the bar up your body, elbows moving back.
Slide it back down the same way.
rangeOfMotion: Bar at your thighs → bar at your chest

name: Cable Spider Curl
why: Spider curl on a cable: arms in front, tension at the bottom too.
setup: Chest on a 45° bench facing a low pulley.
Bench far enough back that the cable pulls at the bottom.
form: Curl up and squeeze.
Lower until your arms are straight.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Spider Hammer Curl
why: Hammer curl with your chest on a bench: arms in front, no swinging.
setup: Chest on a 45° bench.
Dumbbells hanging straight down, palms facing in.
form: Curl up, thumbs leading, squeeze.
Lower until your arms are straight.
tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

name: Bayesian Hammer Curl
why: Bayesian curl with a rope, palm in: arm behind you, thumb up.
setup: Rope on a low pulley. Face away, rope in one hand.
Step forward until your arm is pulled behind you, palm in.
form: Curl up, keeping your elbow back and your palm in.
Lower until your arm is straight.
rangeOfMotion: Arm straight behind you → full curl
